claims.head: Watch for Tolvanen, Cuylle, Laba against Kucherov, Point, Goncalves
claims.call: NY Rangers’s L2 spends at least 46% of its 5-on-5 time against Tampa Bay’s second line.
claims.body: At home, NY Rangers’s L2 (Tolvanen, Cuylle, Laba) has spent 46% of its 5-on-5 time against opponents’ second lines. With no line matching it would be about 29%. Tonight Tampa Bay’s usual second line is Kucherov, Point, Goncalves.

claims.head: Volume against patience
claims.body: On shot volume, Tampa Bay sits 4th of 32, at the relentless end of the scale. NY Rangers is 27th, at the selective end.

NYR.head: NY Rangers starts a half-step behind
NYR.body: Tampa Bay has controlled the play far better over recent games and NY Rangers has home ice. NY Rangers’s best way to tip it is pouncing on loose pucks.

TBL.body: Tampa Bay has controlled the play far better over recent games and NY Rangers has home ice. NY Rangers can still swing it if it pounces on loose pucks.
